layout.arrangement: Red serif title centered at top with a yellow circular slide-number badge '45' at the top-right corner. Below the title, a full-width pale-yellow highlight box with blue border holds three lines of blue/red annotation text. The remaining ~65% of the slide is one large blue-bordered architecture diagram read bottom-to-top: X vector row at bottom, yellow caption strip under it, a dark-blue 'Multi Head Self Attention Block' bar, blue up-arrows, a Y vector row inside a green dashed container that also holds red '+' circles and a gray 'Layer Normalization' bar, a second Y vector row, a blue-bordered 'Feed Forward Networks' box containing 8 mini network icons, and a final top Y vector row. Three two-line text labels ('Output of Self Attention' blue, 'Residual Connections' orange, 'Input to Self Attention' red) run down the left margin outside the diagram, each aligned with its corresponding diagram feature. A thin black strip spans the very bottom edge (likely captured video-player progress bar).

layout.hierarchy: The red serif title is the largest text. The dark-blue attention bar is the heaviest single color mass and anchors the diagram. The pale-yellow annotation box is the secondary reading block. Diagram labels are small bold serif; vector-stack labels are smallest. Red is used for emphasis (title, X labels, '+', 'Layer', RELU tags), blue for structure (borders, attention block, arrows), green and orange only for flow/residual cues.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2), 16:9. 2. Add centered bold red (#C00000) serif title 'Feed Forward Neural Network' (~40pt) at top. 3. Top-right: insert a yellow (#FFD966) circle (~0.9in) with black outline and black serif text '45'. 4. Below title, insert a full-width (approx 9in x 1.1in) rectangle filled #FFFFCC with 2pt #0000CC border; inside place three left-aligned bold serif lines (~18pt): line 1 'Feed Forward Network for each Vector ' in #0000CC + '(After applying Normalization)' in #C00000; line 2 'One Hidden Layer with RELU Activation,' in #0000CC (make 'RELU' ~22pt) + tab/space + '[Size: at least double Input dimension]' with '[Size:' and ']' in #C00000 and inner text #0000CC; line 3 'Linear Activation Output Layer' in #0000CC ('Linear' bold) + '[Size: same Input Vector dimension]' colored as line 2. 5. Insert a large white rectangle (~12in x 5.8in) with 2.5pt #0000CC border as the diagram frame covering the lower two-thirds. 6. Build a 'vector stack' group: four stacked small rectangles colored top-to-bottom #F4B8C4, #FFE699, #C6E0B4, #BDD7EE, with a bold dark-red (#990000) subscripted label below; duplicate 8x per row for four rows (labels Y_1..Y_6, Y_{N-1}, Y_N on the three upper rows; X_1..X_6, X_{N-1}, X_N on the bottom row, labels in #C00000). Between the 6th and 7th stack of each row place 5 small dots (dark blue #00008B for Y rows, green #00B050 for the X row). 7. Bottom of frame: add the X row; beneath/overlapping it add a yellow (#FFFF00) highlighted text box with bold italic red (#C00000) text 'Word_Embedding + Positional_Information'. 8. Above the X row place a full-width navy (#00008B) rectangle with centered white bold serif text 'Multi Head Self Attention Block'. 9. Add 8 blue up block-arrows from the X row to the bar and 8 from the bar to the Y row above. 10. Insert a green dashed rounded rectangle (#00B050 dashed border) enclosing the upper diagram section; inside it, top to bottom: a light-gray (#D9D9D9) full-width bar with centered text 'Layer' (red bold italic) + 'Normalization' (black bold); below it a row of 8 dark-red (#990000) circles with white bold '+'; below those the third Y vector row. 11. Draw 8 thin green up-arrows from the Y row to the '+' circles and 8 from the '+' circles into the gray bar. 12. Draw 8 semi-transparent orange (#E8A020) curved arrows bowing outward from the Y row up to each '+' circle (residual skip connections). 13. Above the dashed container place the second Y vector row, then a white rectangle with 2pt #0000CC border titled in blue bold 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden with  RELU Activation]'; inside, place 8 small white tiles each containing ~6 green dots with thin black lines fanning up to a point and tiny red 'RELU' text, separated after the 6th tile by 5 blue dots. 14. Place the top Y vector row above the FFN box. 15. In the left margin outside the frame, stack three two-line bold serif labels aligned to their features: 'Output of Self Attention' (#0000CC), 'Residual Connections' (#E8A020), 'Input to Self Attention' (#C00000). 16. Optionally add a thin black rectangle across the very bottom edge only if replicating the captured video frame; omit if recreating the slide alone.
